fusions.name: Flank Scrape
fusions.desc: Scrapes a crusted flank along the target, which deals 4 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: False Island
fusions.desc: Surfaces a reef-crusted back 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. It deals 26 damage that ignores armour to each enemy that crosses it and leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fallen Giant
fusions.desc: Raises a reef 3 tiles around where you stand. For 8 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Grown-Over Hide
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (28% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
